title: Organisation — LucrumTech
description: We build the organisation behind the business — structure, leadership, people and operating model — for companies being built and companies that have outgrown their structure.
h1Muted: Organisation is what lets it keep running at scale.
lede: We build the organisation behind the business — structure, leadership, people and operating model. For companies being built, and for companies that have outgrown the structure that once worked.

argument.h2: Not a bigger team. Not more process. The right system for the next stage.
argument.body: A great product needs more than great technology. It needs the right leadership, the right capabilities, the right people, the right operating model.
argument.body2: The work can start before there is an organisation, when there is only an idea. Or when a business has outgrown the structure that got it here. In both cases the objective is the same: build the right organisation for the business you are creating.

model.h2: The real question is rarely "who should we hire?"
model.body: It's: what organisation does this business need in order to work, grow and create value?
model.chain: Business model → capabilities → organisation → leadership → team → operating model → launch → scale

blocks.p: People strategy, organisational design, workforce planning, leadership architecture, performance management, culture.
Organisational architecture, team design, critical capabilities, leadership team, hiring strategy, in-house vs outsource, scaling model.
Organisational audit, redesign, operating model, roles and accountability, leadership transitions, team rebuild.
C-level, VP and head-level roles — from search and assessment through selection, offer and 90-day integration.

hiring.h2: A placement that leaves in month three was never a placement.
hiring.body: Hiring runs on a defined process — intake through onboarding and probation follow-up, tracked in ATS with agreed response times at every stage. No black box, no candidate going quiet for three weeks.
hiring.body2: Most interviews test whether someone can do the job. We test three things: capability, fit with how the team actually works, and whether this is somewhere they will still want to be in two years. What the interview surfaces then shapes the onboarding — so the first 90 days are built around the specific person, not a template.

track.body: 11+ years in technology. End-to-end organisational rebuilds delivered in three months. Across IT, outsourcing and outstaffing, technology products, FinTech, media, international businesses, corporations, holding structures and subsidiaries.
